about.antibeast_body:
When AntiBeast is enabled, @everyone gains mention permission and turning off mentionable stops working; MentionLimit then automatically switches to enforcing via an AutoMod rule.
Adding a role also adds it to the AntiBeast bypass list (removing it does not take it back out).
about.automod_mode_body:
The role stays permanently mentionable; during the cooldown a native Discord AutoMod rule blocks mentions of it instead.
Note: AutoMod does not apply to admins or the server owner, so they can still mention the role during a cooldown.
about.default_mode_body: After a mention, temporarily turns off the role's "Allow anyone to @mention this role", then restores the original setting when the cooldown ends.
about.desc:
Adds a cooldown to freely-mentionable roles (like a "ping me" role):
once the role is mentioned, further mentions are blocked for a while and restored automatically when the cooldown ends.
about.other_body:
"Count admins" makes admin mentions trigger the cooldown too (off by default).
"Cooldown announcement" posts a notice in the channel when a cooldown starts (off by default).

AutoMod mode: block with an AutoMod rule during the cooldown; the role stays mentionable.
When off: temporarily turn off the role's "Allow anyone to @mention this role" during the cooldown.

@everyone and integration-managed roles are excluded automatically.
